meta.note: Logical group view — each node represents a cluster of related components, not individual files

nodes.label: Orchestrators
nodes.summary: /run · /thorough_plan · /triage — Route user intent to the right workflow phase.
nodes.details_md:
## Orchestrators

The three skills that route and sequence the entire workflow:

- **/run** — end-to-end chain: discover → architect → plan → implement → review → end_of_task. Pauses at each gate.
- **/thorough_plan** — triages task by size (Small/Medium/Large) and runs the plan→critic→revise convergence loop.
- **/triage** — lightweight router that reads a prompt and proposes the right skill.

All three are Opus-tier, Claude-adapter only.

nodes.label: Planning Skills
nodes.summary: /discover · /architect · /plan · /critic · /revise · /revise-fast — Produce and converge on an implementation plan.
nodes.details_md:
## Planning Skills

Produces plans through a convergence loop:

1. **/discover** — scans all repos, produces inventory + dependency map
2. **/architect** — deep analysis, produces `architecture.md` with stage decomposition (internal critic loop max 2–4 rounds)
3. **/plan** — detailed implementation-ready plan (always Opus)
4. **/critic** — finds gaps, risks, integration issues (always Opus)
5. **/revise** — addresses critic feedback (Opus in strict mode)
6. **/revise-fast** — cost-efficient Sonnet revision for medium tasks

**Outputs:** `architecture.md`, `current-plan.md`, `critic-response-N.md`

nodes.label: Execution Skills
nodes.details_md:
## Execution Skills

Turn the plan into shipped code:

- **/implement** — executes tasks from the plan, writing code and tests (Sonnet)
- **/gate** — automated quality checkpoint; requires explicit human approval before proceeding
- **/review** — deep code review, verifies implementation matches plan (Opus)
- **/rollback** — safely undoes implementation phases
- **/end_of_task** — commits, pushes branch, logs lessons, marks task complete

**Outputs:** code changes, `review-N.md`, `gate-*.md`

nodes.label: Session Lifecycle
nodes.summary: /start_of_day · /end_of_day · /checkpoint · /sleep — Save and restore session state across work sessions.
nodes.details_md:
## Session Lifecycle Skills

Manages state between sessions so work can be resumed:

- **/start_of_day** — restores context from daily cache, checks git state
- **/end_of_day** — consolidates all sessions into daily cache, invokes /sleep
- **/checkpoint** — general-purpose state save (mid-session, between sessions, before heavy work); writes pending-restore sentinel
- **/sleep** — scans daily insights, promotes to `lessons-learned.md` or soft-forgets

**Artifacts:** `sessions/`, `daily/`, `checkpoints/`, `lessons-learned.md`

nodes.label: Utilities
nodes.details_md:
## Utility Skills

Supporting tools for day-to-day use:

- **/init_workflow** — bootstraps the workflow structure in a new project (run once)
- **/capture_insight** — logs an observation to the daily insights scratchpad without interrupting work
- **/cost_snapshot** — reports today's cost, project lifetime cost, per-task breakdown
- **/expand** — decompresses terse (Tier 3) workflow artifacts back to English
- **/next_steps** — append-only queue for future work items

nodes.label: Hook System
nodes.summary: UserPromptSubmit · SessionStart · SessionEnd · PreCompact · PostCompact · worktreecreate.sh · _lib.sh — Event-driven automation deployed to ~/.claude/hooks/.
nodes.details_md:
## Hook System

Bash scripts that fire on Claude Code lifecycle events:

- **userpromptsubmit.sh** — run-continuation sentinels only (clears the arm, stamps /run consent); never reads the transcript
- **sessionstart.sh** — surfaces pending-restore banner; checks end_of_day_due flag; dedicated `compact`-matcher branch emits a post-compaction re-entry advisory when an active run matches the session
- **sessionend.sh** — signals end-of-day reminder (non-blocking banner)
- **precompact.sh** — intercepts auto-compact; always allows; writes a checkpoint when a run is active or skills are running, otherwise writes nothing (opt back in with QUOIN_PRECOMPACT_NORUN_CHECKPOINT=1)
- **postcompact.sh** — writes compact-happened sentinel
- **worktreecreate.sh** — resolves a nested git root and self-generates an isolated worktree for source-mutating skill dispatches
- **_lib.sh** — shared helpers: read_constants, compute_utilization, trash_move, pidfile ops

All hooks **fail-OPEN** (exit 0 on any error). Tunable via `QUOIN_*` env vars.

nodes.label: Model Dispatch
nodes.summary: §0 Cost Guard · §0' Pollution Guard · Spawn Preamble — Keep expensive models from running cheap-tier work.
nodes.details_md:
## Model Dispatch

Two automatic dispatch layers enforce cost discipline:

**§0 — Cost guardrail (15 cheap-tier skills):** If a Haiku/Sonnet skill is invoked from an Opus session, it self-dispatches to its declared model via Agent tool. Uses `[no-redispatch]` sentinel to prevent recursion.

**§0' — Pollution guard (7 Opus-tier skills):** If `pollution_guard.py` prints `OVER` (score ≥ 5000, context is too large), spawns a fresh Agent subagent. Score = `transcript_kb + (agent_returns × 5) + (reads × 1) + (bash_calls × 1)`.

**Spawn Preamble:** 7 spawn-target skills read `preamble.md` first to pre-warm the prompt cache for `format-kit.md §3` + `glossary.md`.

All dispatch: fail-OPEN on Agent unavailable.

nodes.label: Memory Files
nodes.summary: ~/.claude/memory/ — Tier 1 reference files loaded at skill bootstrap: format-kit, glossary, lifecycle-guide, dispatch-guide, cost-ledger-format, sleep-signals, …
nodes.details_md:
## Memory Files

Tier 1 hand-edited reference files, deployed to `~/.claude/memory/` by `install.sh`:

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `format-kit.md` | Artifact format primitives and allowed sections |
| `glossary.md` | Abbreviation whitelist + status glyphs |
| `lifecycle-guide.md` | Checkpoint/sleep/end_of_day lifecycle rules |
| `dispatch-guide.md` | §0/§0' dispatch contract details |
| `cost-ledger-format.md` | 7-column ledger row format |
| `hooks-table.md` | Hook event/matcher table with tunable constants |
| `sleep-signals.yaml` | Importance scoring weights for /sleep |
| `terse-rubric.md`, `format-kit-pitfalls.md`, etc. | Writing guidance for skills |

**All are Tier 1:** always human-readable English, never compressed.

nodes.label: Workflow Artifacts
nodes.summary: .workflow_artifacts/ — File-based shared memory between sessions: plans, reviews, session state, cost ledger, checkpoints, daily cache.
nodes.details_md:
## Workflow Artifacts

File-based shared memory between sessions, stored under `.workflow_artifacts/`:

```
.workflow_artifacts/
  <task-name>/
    architecture.md         ← Tier 1 contract doc
    current-plan.md         ← Tier 2/3 plan
    critic-response-N.md    ← critic rounds
    review-N.md             ← review results
    gate-*.md               ← gate audit logs
    cost-ledger.md          ← per-task cost log
    stage-N/                ← multi-stage tasks
  memory/
    sessions/               ← per-session state files
    daily/                  ← daily cache + insights
    checkpoints/            ← checkpoint save files
    lessons-learned.md      ← institutional memory
  cache/                    ← advisory knowledge cache
  finalized/                ← completed tasks
```

**Skills are session-independent:** file artifacts are the only shared memory.

nodes.label: Core Scripts
nodes.summary: path_resolve · validate_artifact · cost_event · generate_discovery_map · select_unprocessed_sessions — Portable Python utilities deployed to ~/.claude/scripts/.
nodes.details_md:
## Core Scripts

Portable Python utilities (runtime-neutral), canonical in `quoin/core/scripts/`, deployed via wrapper in `quoin/scripts/`:

- **path_resolve.py** — maps `stage N of <task>` to `.workflow_artifacts/<task>/stage-N/`
- **validate_artifact.py** — structural validator for plan/review/architecture artifacts
- **cost_event.py** — cost-ledger row schema and parser
- **generate_discovery_map.py** — stdlib-only discovery map generator
- **select_unprocessed_sessions.py** — shared session-selection helper for end_of_day + weekly_review
- **validate_adapter_drift.py** — checks base vs adapter skill divergence
- **build_preambles.py** (Claude adapter) — generates §0 preamble sections in SKILL.md files
- **cost_from_jsonl.py** (Claude adapter) — parses Claude Code JSONL for cost tracking

nodes.label: Installer
nodes.summary: install.sh · installer.py — Deploys skills, memory, scripts, hooks to ~/.claude/. Run once per machine; re-run after every pull.
nodes.details_md:
## Installer

`bash quoin/install.sh` deploys the entire Claude adapter to `~/.claude/`:

- **Skills** — all 32 SKILL.md files to `~/.claude/skills/` (overlay rule: claude adapter overrides base)
- **Memory files** — all Tier 1 reference files to `~/.claude/memory/`
- **Scripts** — Python utilities to `~/.claude/scripts/`
- **Hooks** — 7 bash scripts to `~/.claude/hooks/`; registers 8 stanzas in `settings.json`
- **Preambles** — runs `build_preambles.py` to inject §0 dispatch blocks into skill files

`installer.py` handles the overlay logic and PLACEHOLDER token substitution for `~/.claude/` paths.

**Re-run after every `git pull`** — deployed copies at `~/.claude/` are not auto-updated.
